simple.meaning: סְלִק (çᵉliq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to ascend.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 4:12. Its contexts include kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְלִק (H5559).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סְלִק (çᵉliq) / H5559 is traced through Ezra 4:12, Daniel 2:29, Daniel 7:3, Daniel 7:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls, and repaired the foundations.

timeline.evidenceText: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls, and repaired the foundations.
“As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.
Four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.

“I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots: and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

and concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke great things, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

definitions.full: H5559. cliq [ סְלֵק ] verb come up (Aramaic loan-word in Biblical Hebrew, q. v.); — Pe`al Perfect 3feminine singular סִלְקַת Dan 7:20 , תָ֯ (!) 7:28 (K § 25 b )); 3 masculine plural סְלִ֫קוּ 2:29 ; Ezra 4:12 ; Participle feminine plural סָֽלְקָן Dan 7:3 ; — come up , מִן person Ezra 4:12 , מִןיַֿמָּא Dan 7:3 ; absolute of horn in vision 7:8 , 20 ; figurative of thoughts 2:29 . Haph`el lift, take up : Perfect 3masculine plural הַסִּ֫קוּ (as if from נסק ; K § 44 b )) Dan 3:22 ; Infinitive לְהַנְסָקָה (K l. e. Str § 3 h ) 6:24 ( מִן local), both with ל accusative of person Hoph`al (W CG225 ) be taken up: Perfect 3masculine singular הֻסַּק Dan 6:24 ( מִן local).
